Author: SunnysOfficial
Name: Venue Mapper
Description: A Dalamud plugin for discovering FFXIV venues with 2D/3D interactive markers, live events, and built-in owner tools. Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
Changelog:
## v0.6.0

- Changed: New look for the whole plugin: gold only for titles and headings, every venue in its own colors, angular shapes and calmer effects
- Added: All buttons, toggles, checkboxes, dropdowns, sliders and text fields use the plugin's own style, including their hover effects
- Changed: The main window is now called VenueMapper and has a new angular frame with its own title bar. Notification History, Update Notes, Minimize and Close are now right there
- Changed: Settings are sorted into six groups with their own color and icon: General, Directory, Markers & map, Notifications, Accessibility and Data & sync. Every option has a short explanation and the layout fits any window size
- Changed: New look for notifications: angular cards in the color of what they are about, with a short detail line
- Added: Big announcements: arriving at a venue or festival and a favorite opening show as a banner in the middle of the screen. Can be turned off in Settings
- Added: The main window can be minimized to its title bar with the button or a double click on the title bar
- Added: New Update Notes window after an update: versions grouped by series, hotfixes shown with their version, new things listed first, a colored label for each kind of change and sections you can fold, plus a Credits tab. It also opens from the document icon in the title bar
- Added: The Credits now name who designed the plugin logo
- Changed: The "Visit" button is now called "Teleport" and has its own aetheryte icon
- Changed: The active tab is now marked with an underline
- Changed: The venue form, the update form and the festival form use the same angular frame and title bar as the main window
- Fixed: Icons now sit exactly in the middle of their circles and boxes
- Added: Overview at the top: how many venues are open now, how many open today and how many festivals are live. Click a number to filter
- Added: Quick filters: Open now, Favorites, Open today and My data center
- Added: Venues are grouped into Open now, Opening soon and the other venues (setting "Group by status")
- Improved: Every venue shows its own colors, a live open status, its address and its next event
- Changed: Clicking a venue opens its details, or the map when you are inside it
- Fixed: Venue names and Partake event titles no longer show broken symbols for emojis the font can't display
- Improved: Very dark venue colors are shown a little lighter so they stay readable
- Changed: The link buttons under each venue are now small icons that show up when you hover a venue: Share, Partake, website and Discord
- Added: Venues that advertise in the Party Finder get a megaphone icon while their listing is up, click it to open the listing. The plugin only reads the listings you see when you open the Party Finder
- Added: Clickable venues in chat: venue names, addresses like "Goblet W5 P12" and links to a venue page on the VenueMapper website become links, click one to open the venue. Plain words only count when the message also has a hint like a ward, a server or "open", and you can pick the chat channels in Settings
- Added: Share a venue: copy it for chat, for Discord with its links, as a web link to its page on the VenueMapper website, as a Lifestream command, or set a map flag to post with <flag>. In the Directory, the right-click menu and Venue Details
- Added: The About tab and the Credits link to the VenueMapper website and its step by step guide for venue owners
- Changed: Completely new, bigger 3D markers: a round badge with the service icon, icon and name together in one bubble when you are close, and a soft glow on the floor. They stay sharp at every marker size, and the larger sizes are only a bit bigger
- Improved: Markers fade behind walls and with distance, and the floor glow follows stairs and uneven floors
- Added: New marker settings: names always, only nearby or off, show through walls, and venue colors instead of one color per service type
- Changed: Strong pulse now adds an expanding ring on the floor and a brighter badge edge
- Added: Venues above houses: in a housing ward, every venue gets a marker above its house, like a map flag in the world, with its initials, name, opening time and distance. It grows a little the farther away you are
- Added: Settings for venues above houses: all venues, open venues only, favorites only or off, and a range up to the whole ward you are in
- Added: Venues on the game map and minimap with their own goblet icon instead of the plot's house icon, as game markers, drawn over the map, or both
- Added: Find your way inside: click a service on the map and a line on the floor points you straight there, and over the stairs when the spot is on another floor. It stops by itself once you can see the spot. Pick an arrow, sparkles, a pulse or dots as animation, in one color or in the venue's colors
- Improved: 3D markers stay behind the game's own windows and dialogs, like the Yes/No questions
- Improved: With a custom marker color, badges and bubbles are filled with that color and their text switches to black or white, whichever is easier to read
- Fixed: 3D markers no longer stay on screen after teleporting away or during a loading screen
- Added: Venue Details and the Directory tooltip show a banner: the venue's own banner, its FFXIVVenues banner or the art of its housing district
- Added: Owners can add a link to their own banner image in the venue form
- Improved: Venues now use all three of their colors in the Directory, on the map and on their name boxes
- Added: Notification when one of your favorite venues opens. Can be turned off in Settings
- Added: House rules: venues can list a few short rules. You see them in a card when you arrive (every visit, first visit or off) and any time with the Rules button in the map tab
- Added: Owners can add house rules in the venue form, in English and optionally in German, each with its own icon
- Added: House placards in a housing ward show the venue's name and when it opens instead of "Placard". Can be turned off in Settings
- Added: New Festivals tab with upcoming and live festivals, including date, time, location and organizer
- Added: Festivals can take place in a housing ward or anywhere in the open world
- Added: Teleport to a festival through Lifestream (world travel and the nearest aetheryte) and "Show on map" with the festival area
- Added: At a festival you get a welcome message, the Map tab shows the festival area and its stalls, and 3D markers point to stalls and stages
- Added: Reminders before a festival starts, using the event reminder setting
- Added: Organizers can submit a festival with the new festival form (Festivals tab or "/vmapper festival")
- Added: Festivals can run over several days with their own times, and can include several houses in a ward
- Added: The festival form has a Where & when tab: take your position, add the house you are standing in and add more days. Organizers can also preview their festival in game before sending it, only on their own PC
- Improved: Nicer festival list with a date tile, the current festival day, stall icons and a schedule you can unfold
- Added: Teleporting to a festival also sets a map flag on the festival area
- Added: Venue passport in the Easter eggs tab: every venue you go inside while it is open gets a stamp with its name around the ring, the date and number of visits, plus badges like Night owl or All 5 districts. Closed venues are greyed out and don't count, new venues in the list are tagged New for two weeks. Stored only on your PC, per character
- Removed: Two older easter eggs, to make room for the passport
- Added: The plugin now also works in a venue's garden: welcome message, quick popup and auto open
- Added: New Garden tab on the map shows the ward map zoomed onto the plot
- Added: Owners can place services in the garden with the new "Garden" floor in the venue form, shown as 3D markers
- Improved: Walking past a garden does not trigger messages, you need to stay on the plot for a moment
- Added: Ward view on the map: in a housing ward, the whole ward map shows all venues of this ward as pins with their name, click a pin for details. It opens zoomed in on the ward and goes up to 10x, a double click goes back
- Added: Garden markers show up as soon as you step onto the venue's plot
- Fixed: Venues are now also matched by housing district, so a venue with the same ward and plot in another district no longer counts. Works with every game language
- Fixed: The "HERE" badge in the Directory only shows for the venue you are really at
- Improved: Floors are now read from the game's own floor maps, so the floor switches exactly on stairs and floor tabs also show maps of floors you have not visited yet
- Added: "Show on map" in the venue right-click menu and in the Venue Details window opens the game map with a flag on the venue's plot
- Added: Click the Teleport button again while teleporting to cancel it
- Added: A warning appears when Lifestream could not enter the house after a teleport
- Fixed: In subdivision wards (plots 31 to 60) the garden map and ward pins showed the wrong part of the map
- Improved: The plugin does less work every frame: location tracking is lighter and the Directory no longer starts a Partake lookup for every venue while the data is still fresh
- Fixed: Event times now always show AM/PM. On some system languages it was missing, so 6 AM and 6 PM looked the same
- Fixed: The Events tab and the Venue Details window now show the same Server Time (ST) for an event, Venue Details used to show local time
- Fixed: Open/closed status now updates live instead of keeping the state from the last download, which could be up to 30 minutes old
- Fixed: The plugin no longer keeps sending requests to Partake after an event lookup fails or for teams without a logo
- Removed: Removed the "EVENT" label from event cards, it was the same on every card
- Improved: Venue schedule data is now downloaded over an encrypted connection (HTTPS)
- Improved: Links from venue data only open web addresses
- Improved: Banners, logos and the venue list only load over HTTPS and have a download size limit
- Improved: An image that fails to load is tried again a few times later instead of never
- Fixed: A broken or incomplete venue list download could overwrite the saved list and still report "Venue list updated"
- Fixed: When saving the downloaded venue list failed, the plugin still treated it as up to date and did not download it again
- Fixed: With "Update venue list on start" turned off, the venue list was still downloaded right after login and every hour
- Fixed: The setup wizard came back on every start after choosing Skip or closing it
- Fixed: A floor tab on the map could show the interior map of a previously visited venue
- Fixed: The Directory server filter now matches the venue's server exactly
- Fixed: Dragging that starts outside the map no longer moves the map
- Fixed: Deleting a service in the venue form could briefly hide the next one
- Improved: The venue form export now always includes a ground floor
- Fixed: Venue form: "Detect position" now finds the district with every game language
- Fixed: Venue form: plot sizes now come from the game data, two Empyreum plots were shown as Small instead of Medium
- Improved: Saving and downloads are more robust: cache files are saved crash-safe through Dalamud, and background downloads stop cleanly when the plugin is unloaded or updated
- Improved: Long window titles are shortened, hover over them to see the full title
- Improved: Long notifications now wrap onto several lines instead of growing very wide
- Changed: The Debug window only shows what you need to report a location problem
- Changed: The Update Notes window now also appears when an update skips over a version that has one
